metrics.name: CEC — Capital Eligibility Coverage
metrics.definition: The share of development-package cost in an eligible-or-later workflow state.
metrics.formula: Σ cost(packages in evidenced…closed) / Σ cost(all packages).
metrics.inputs: development packages: cost_amount (EUR), workflow_state — the owner's register
metrics.timing: Live, at the time of the request.
metrics.valuation_boundary: All packages, or post-FID packages only (labelled).
metrics.access: SUMMARY: the owner and GEX staff get every package; anyone else gets post-FID packages only, labelled, unless the owner shares SUMMARY (read in the owner's tenant).
metrics.decision_test: None attributed. Its status bands (50% warn, 85% target) are typed in pre_cod_metrics.py, not policy values — for JML's review.
metrics.limitations: Counts cost, not evidence quality. Typed status bands.

metrics.name: DSCR (minimum and average, deterministic)
metrics.definition: CFADS over debt service in each operating year with debt service; minimum and average.
metrics.formula: DSCR_t = (EBITDA − tax after interest − maintenance capex)_t / (interest + principal)_t; annuity debt from COD.
metrics.inputs: FCI (EUR, owner's TEA case); pre-FID spend by year (EUR, owner's DEVEX register or spend wave); revenue and OPEX (EUR/yr, TEA case); ramp-up (fraction of full output, owner); COD year and month (owner); construction schedule (EUR by year, reconciles to FCI within 0.5%); tax rate and depreciation life (owner); residual value (EUR, owner); debt amount (EUR), interest rate (fraction/yr), tenor (years) — owner's financing terms
metrics.timing: Annual periods, year 0 = FID; part-year COD pro-rated; stated with every result (`timing`).
metrics.valuation_boundary: FULL_PROJECT (pre-FID spend before year 0) or FROM_FID (pre-FID spend sunk). Never compared with each other.
metrics.access: RETURNS: the owner's finance and executive functions; anyone else only through a RETURNS share of a published case version (`RETURNS_SHARE:<version>`). RETURNS never opens DEVEX sections.
metrics.decision_test: DSCR_P50 / DSCR_DEFAULT tests take recorded P50/P90 figures, not this deterministic value. The registry floors (`dscr_floor_p50`, `dscr_default_floor`, `dscr_covenant_floor`) are GEX proposed.
metrics.limitations: Annual periods; no monthly dating. A model result, not an assured outcome: valid only on the stated case, inputs and assumptions. Deterministic: no P50/P90 here. No DSRA, sculpting or sweep in this model.

metrics.name: DSCR P50 (recorded)
metrics.definition: The base-case DSCR as recorded for the project.
metrics.formula: Not computed by GEX. Read from the project's recorded structuring inputs (`project_dataset` kind `structuring_context`).
metrics.inputs: dscr_p50 (x), recorded by the owner; UNVERIFIED unless verified
metrics.timing: As recorded; no timing stated by the record.
metrics.decision_test: DSCR_P50 against `dscr_floor_p50` (senior lender; GEX proposed). Feeds SENIOR_DEBT_COMMITMENT, never a gate.
metrics.limitations: A recorded figure, not an engine result. Missing → not assessable.

metrics.name: DSCR P90 (recorded)
metrics.definition: The downside (P90) DSCR as recorded for the project.
metrics.formula: Not computed by GEX. Read from the recorded structuring inputs.
metrics.decision_test: DSCR_P90 against `dscr_floor_p90`; DSCR_DEFAULT (the deal killer) against `dscr_default_floor`. Both GEX proposed: no pass/fail until approved.
metrics.limitations: A recorded figure. Missing → not assessable, never a breach.

metrics.name: Hurdle rates (project and equity)
metrics.definition: Project hurdle = after-tax WACC + project risk premium. Equity hurdle = cost of equity.
metrics.formula: Ke = stated, or rf + β × ERP + country premium + technology premium; WACC = E/(E+D)·Ke + D/(E+D)·Kd·(1−t) on the structure at FID; grants outside the weights.
metrics.inputs: cost of equity or rf, β, ERP (owner); country, technology and project premiums (owner; registry keys `project_risk_premium`, `technology_risk_premium` are GEX proposed); equity and debt at FID (EUR); cost of debt; tax rate
metrics.timing: A single rate for the life of the case, stated with the result.
metrics.valuation_boundary: FULL_PROJECT (pre-FID spend before year 0) or FROM_FID (pre-FID spend sunk). Never compared with each other.
metrics.access: RETURNS: the owner's finance and executive functions; anyone else only through a RETURNS share of a published case version (`RETURNS_SHARE:<version>`). RETURNS never opens DEVEX sections.
metrics.decision_test: It IS the threshold of the IRR tests; its premiums are policy values (proposed until JML approves).
metrics.limitations: Premiums typed by the owner are the owner's assumptions, labelled so.

metrics.name: Levered (equity) IRR
metrics.definition: The IRR of the cash flows to equity.
metrics.formula: IRR of: −pre-FID spend, −equity paid in by construction year (IDC included), then EBITDA − tax on (EBITDA − depreciation − interest) − maintenance capex − interest − principal, + residual value.
metrics.inputs: FCI (EUR, owner's TEA case); pre-FID spend by year (EUR, owner's DEVEX register or spend wave); revenue and OPEX (EUR/yr, TEA case); ramp-up (fraction of full output, owner); COD year and month (owner); construction schedule (EUR by year, reconciles to FCI within 0.5%); tax rate and depreciation life (owner); residual value (EUR, owner); debt amount (EUR), interest rate (fraction/yr), tenor (years) — owner's financing terms
metrics.timing: Annual periods, year 0 = FID; part-year COD pro-rated; stated with every result (`timing`).
metrics.valuation_boundary: FULL_PROJECT (pre-FID spend before year 0) or FROM_FID (pre-FID spend sunk). Never compared with each other.
metrics.access: RETURNS: the owner's finance and executive functions; anyone else only through a RETURNS share of a published case version (`RETURNS_SHARE:<version>`). RETURNS never opens DEVEX sections.
metrics.decision_test: Against the equity hurdle = cost of equity (stated, or built up). `sponsor_equity_hurdle` is a GEX-proposed registry value; no approved value means no pass/fail.
metrics.limitations: Annual periods; no monthly dating. A model result, not an assured outcome: valid only on the stated case, inputs and assumptions. Kept separate from project returns.

metrics.name: LLCR (loan-life coverage ratio)
metrics.definition: NPV of CFADS over the loan life, at the debt interest rate, over debt outstanding at COD.
metrics.formula: LLCR = Σ_{t=1..tenor} CFADS_t / (1 + i)^t / debt at COD.
metrics.inputs: FCI (EUR, owner's TEA case); pre-FID spend by year (EUR, owner's DEVEX register or spend wave); revenue and OPEX (EUR/yr, TEA case); ramp-up (fraction of full output, owner); COD year and month (owner); construction schedule (EUR by year, reconciles to FCI within 0.5%); tax rate and depreciation life (owner); residual value (EUR, owner); debt amount (EUR), interest rate (fraction/yr), tenor (years) — owner's financing terms
metrics.timing: Annual periods, year 0 = FID; part-year COD pro-rated; stated with every result (`timing`).
metrics.valuation_boundary: FULL_PROJECT (pre-FID spend before year 0) or FROM_FID (pre-FID spend sunk). Never compared with each other.
metrics.access: RETURNS: the owner's finance and executive functions; anyone else only through a RETURNS share of a published case version (`RETURNS_SHARE:<version>`). RETURNS never opens DEVEX sections.
metrics.decision_test: `llcr_floor` is a GEX-proposed registry value; no decision test is wired to it yet.
metrics.limitations: Annual periods; no monthly dating. A model result, not an assured outcome: valid only on the stated case, inputs and assumptions. Validated against independent expectations (tests/test_returns_expectations.py). Unavailable in structuring, which shows no LLCR estimate.

metrics.name: NPV (project and equity)
metrics.definition: Net present value at FID of the project flows (at the project hurdle) and of the equity flows (at the equity hurdle).
metrics.formula: Σ CF_t / (1 + r)^t, t = 0 at FID; pre-FID flows compounded forward to year 0.
metrics.inputs: FCI (EUR, owner's TEA case); pre-FID spend by year (EUR, owner's DEVEX register or spend wave); revenue and OPEX (EUR/yr, TEA case); ramp-up (fraction of full output, owner); COD year and month (owner); construction schedule (EUR by year, reconciles to FCI within 0.5%); tax rate and depreciation life (owner); residual value (EUR, owner); hurdle rates (computed from the WACC inputs)
metrics.timing: Annual periods, year 0 = FID; part-year COD pro-rated; stated with every result (`timing`).
metrics.valuation_boundary: FULL_PROJECT (pre-FID spend before year 0) or FROM_FID (pre-FID spend sunk). Never compared with each other.
metrics.access: RETURNS: the owner's finance and executive functions; anyone else only through a RETURNS share of a published case version (`RETURNS_SHARE:<version>`). RETURNS never opens DEVEX sections.
metrics.decision_test: None. The sign is shown; GEX sets no NPV threshold.
metrics.limitations: Annual periods; no monthly dating. A model result, not an assured outcome: valid only on the stated case, inputs and assumptions.

metrics.name: Payback (project and equity)
metrics.definition: Years from FID until cumulative cash flow, pre-FID spend included, turns positive.
metrics.formula: First t at which Σ_{s≤t} CF_s ≥ 0, interpolated within the year. Undiscounted, residual value excluded.
metrics.inputs: FCI (EUR, owner's TEA case); pre-FID spend by year (EUR, owner's DEVEX register or spend wave); revenue and OPEX (EUR/yr, TEA case); ramp-up (fraction of full output, owner); COD year and month (owner); construction schedule (EUR by year, reconciles to FCI within 0.5%); tax rate and depreciation life (owner); residual value (EUR, owner)
metrics.timing: Annual periods, year 0 = FID; part-year COD pro-rated; stated with every result (`timing`).
metrics.valuation_boundary: FULL_PROJECT (pre-FID spend before year 0) or FROM_FID (pre-FID spend sunk). Never compared with each other.
metrics.access: RETURNS: the owner's finance and executive functions; anyone else only through a RETURNS share of a published case version (`RETURNS_SHARE:<version>`). RETURNS never opens DEVEX sections.
metrics.limitations: Annual periods; no monthly dating. A model result, not an assured outcome: valid only on the stated case, inputs and assumptions. Null when never reached within the operating life.

metrics.name: Return on equity (average annual)
metrics.definition: Average annual net income over equity invested.
metrics.formula: mean(EBITDA − depreciation − interest − tax) / equity invested (pre-FID spend included in FULL_PROJECT).
metrics.inputs: FCI (EUR, owner's TEA case); pre-FID spend by year (EUR, owner's DEVEX register or spend wave); revenue and OPEX (EUR/yr, TEA case); ramp-up (fraction of full output, owner); COD year and month (owner); construction schedule (EUR by year, reconciles to FCI within 0.5%); tax rate and depreciation life (owner); residual value (EUR, owner); debt amount (EUR), interest rate (fraction/yr), tenor (years) — owner's financing terms
metrics.timing: Annual periods, year 0 = FID; part-year COD pro-rated; stated with every result (`timing`).
metrics.valuation_boundary: FULL_PROJECT (pre-FID spend before year 0) or FROM_FID (pre-FID spend sunk). Never compared with each other.
metrics.access: RETURNS: the owner's finance and executive functions; anyone else only through a RETURNS share of a published case version (`RETURNS_SHARE:<version>`). RETURNS never opens DEVEX sections.
metrics.limitations: Annual periods; no monthly dating. A model result, not an assured outcome: valid only on the stated case, inputs and assumptions. Undiscounted; accounting measure.

metrics.name: Return on investment (average annual and cumulative)
metrics.definition: Average annual NOPAT over total investment; and cumulative unlevered free cash flow plus residual value, less total investment, over total investment.
metrics.formula: roi_avg_annual = mean(NOPAT) / (FCI + pre-FID spend); roi_cumulative = (Σ FCF + RV − total investment) / total investment.
metrics.inputs: FCI (EUR, owner's TEA case); pre-FID spend by year (EUR, owner's DEVEX register or spend wave); revenue and OPEX (EUR/yr, TEA case); ramp-up (fraction of full output, owner); COD year and month (owner); construction schedule (EUR by year, reconciles to FCI within 0.5%); tax rate and depreciation life (owner); residual value (EUR, owner)
metrics.timing: Annual periods, year 0 = FID; part-year COD pro-rated; stated with every result (`timing`).
metrics.valuation_boundary: FULL_PROJECT (pre-FID spend before year 0) or FROM_FID (pre-FID spend sunk). Never compared with each other.
metrics.access: RETURNS: the owner's finance and executive functions; anyone else only through a RETURNS share of a published case version (`RETURNS_SHARE:<version>`). RETURNS never opens DEVEX sections.
metrics.limitations: Annual periods; no monthly dating. A model result, not an assured outcome: valid only on the stated case, inputs and assumptions. Undiscounted.

metrics.name: Unlevered (project) IRR
metrics.definition: The discount rate at which the project's unlevered cash flows have zero NPV.
metrics.formula: IRR of: −pre-FID spend (years before 0), −CAPEX by year, then EBITDA − tax on (EBITDA − depreciation) − maintenance capex, + residual value in the last year. No financing flows, no interest tax shield. Bisection on NPV.
metrics.inputs: FCI (EUR, owner's TEA case); pre-FID spend by year (EUR, owner's DEVEX register or spend wave); revenue and OPEX (EUR/yr, TEA case); ramp-up (fraction of full output, owner); COD year and month (owner); construction schedule (EUR by year, reconciles to FCI within 0.5%); tax rate and depreciation life (owner); residual value (EUR, owner)
metrics.timing: Annual periods, year 0 = FID; part-year COD pro-rated; stated with every result (`timing`).
metrics.valuation_boundary: FULL_PROJECT (pre-FID spend before year 0) or FROM_FID (pre-FID spend sunk). Never compared with each other.
metrics.access: RETURNS: the owner's finance and executive functions; anyone else only through a RETURNS share of a published case version (`RETURNS_SHARE:<version>`). RETURNS never opens DEVEX sections.
metrics.decision_test: Against the project hurdle (after-tax WACC + `project_risk_premium`, registry, GEX proposed). The hurdle is computed; the premium is a policy value. Also the DFI_IRR test (without the DFI's terms) against `dfi_irr_hurdle` of the DFI, as one input only.
metrics.limitations: Annual periods; no monthly dating. A model result, not an assured outcome: valid only on the stated case, inputs and assumptions. Not the sole indicator: always shown with NPV and the downside sensitivities. Undefined when the flows change sign more than once (reported).

metrics.name: WACC (after tax)
metrics.definition: The weighted after-tax cost of equity and debt on the planned structure at FID.
metrics.formula: E/(E+D)·Ke + D/(E+D)·Kd·(1−t); grants outside the weights.
metrics.access: RETURNS: the owner's finance and executive functions; anyone else only through a RETURNS share of a published case version (`RETURNS_SHARE:<version>`). RETURNS never opens DEVEX sections. The structuring WACC is a recorded figure under project access.
metrics.decision_test: WACC against `wacc_target_max` (equity investors' ceiling; GEX proposed). Feeds PROJECT_EQUITY and STRATEGIC_EQUITY, never a gate.
metrics.limitations: Structuring reads a recorded WACC; the engine computes its own on a returns case. They are labelled separately.
